ModifyNextEvent.issue: REVISED 2026-08-04 (stale-sweep re-audit): this entry was `gap`/dormant as of 2026-07-26, reasoning that the sim had no `modify_next_event` hook and no WarHistorianRepy event. Both premises are now false -- re-read in full. `Card.modify_next_event` exists on the sim's base class (cards/base.py:578-585, default `return event_id`, docstring citing `AbstractModel.ModifyNextEvent`/Hook.cs:1830-1836/ActModel.cs:437-443) and `LanternKeyCard.modify_next_event` overrides it exactly as LanternKey.cs:30-37 does: `if (2 != Owner.RunState.CurrentActIndex) return currentEvent; return ModelDb.Event<WarHistorianRepy>();` == `if run.act_index != self.GLORY_ACT_INDEX: return event_id; return "war_historian_repy"`. The dispatch site matches the source shape precisely: `run.py:1509-1524`'s EVENT room-type arm calls `ensure_next_event_is_valid`, then walks `self._map_listeners()` calling `modify_next_event` on each (run.py:1519-1520), then adds the RESULT to `visited_event_ids` -- the same order as `ActModel.PullNextEvent` (EnsureNextEventIsValid -> hook chain -> AddVisitedEvent on the MODIFIED event), so an event whose own `IsAllowed` is False (WarHistorianRepy's is) can still be served, matching the source's documented point. `sts2_rl/events/war_historian_repy.py` is a full port: `is_allowed` returns False (WarHistorianRepy.cs:30-33) with a docstring naming this exact bypass path; the initial UNLOCK_CAGE/UNLOCK_CHEST options, the second-page ShouldGetSecondReward branch (single-player so only the deck-holds-another-key check matters), and both removal helpers are all ported per-line against WarHistorianRepy.cs. Net: the whole mechanism this entry used to call an unfixable, unstaffed dormant gap is shipped and wired correctly. No live/dormant distinction needed any more -- it is faithful on both the RL-training and conformance-replay driver paths, since map generation and event dispatch run identically on both.

ctor.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): `Card.energy_cost` (`sts2_rl/cards/base.py`) now short-circuits on `self._energy_cost < 0` as its first check, returning the raw canonical value before consulting `_free_this_turn` / `_cost_this_turn` / `_cost_this_combat` / `_cost_delta_this_turn` -- mirrors `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers`'s `if (_base < 0) return num;` short-circuit (`CardEnergyCost.cs:101-104`; the record's `:100-103` cite is one line of decompiler drift), which runs before any local or global modifier. All 29 unplayable curse/status/quest cards now set `self._energy_cost = -1` in `_init_vars` (previously 0), each verified individually against its own C# `base(-1, CardType.X, ...)` constructor -- no exceptions, no ascension-gated cost variant. Readers audit (every non-cards/ `energy_cost` hit read in context): combat play/auto-play/valid_actions/action-mask sites gate on `is_playable` first and never see -1; every global-modifier site routes through `hooks.modify_card_energy_cost`, whose dispatcher ends `return max(0, cost)` -- the sim's analogue of C#'s `Math.Max(0, GetWithModifiers(...))` in `GetAmountToSpend`/`GetResolved` (`CardEnergyCost.cs:134-141`) -- so what is SPENT and what the observation encoder reads (`full_env.py` card_features via `previews.py` preview_card_energy_cost) are byte-for-byte unchanged. The three previously-known readers (`relics/mummified_hand.py`, `potions.py` TouchOfInsanity, `cards/event_cards.py` Enlightenment) remain correct, confirmed by unit tests. NOT closed here: `selectors.py`'s `scripted_card_selector` 'to_draw_top' purpose (Headbutt/Thinking Ahead) ranks by raw `card.energy_cost` unclamped -- a sim-only heuristic with no C# analogue; a curse in a Headbutt-eligible discard pile now ranks below-cost instead of tying at 0. No test exercises it; filed in GAP-QUEUE.md's 'Named work with no entry of its own'. New pins: test/test_unplayable_cost.py (15 tests).  The text it replaced read: QUEST / QUEST map exactly, and so does the unusual `TargetType.Self` (LanternKey.cs:17) -- most Quest cards use TargetType.None, and the sim correctly carries SELF here. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses, statuses or quests.
